name: ZoneDetails handler
role: Reads the zone, calls Activate; on failure shows 'Failed to init the game world' and returns 0 before the world is set up
expect: Failed to init the game world for: %s.  Exiting.

name: Holder::Activate
role: Selects terrain implementation `type`, calls its Load(zone name), stores the result in the ok flag (holder+0x24)

name: Holder::IsLoaded
role: Returns 0 while the ok flag is 0, else asks the active implementation (vtable +0x4c)

name: Holder::SetPosition
role: Forwards a position to the active implementation (vtable +0x20)

name: Holder::PendingCount
role: Forwards to the active implementation (vtable +0x40)

name: TerrainController ctor
role: Requests TerrainCalendarDefinitions.txt, creates the 0x1078 and 0x1844 byte helper objects

name: TerrainController::Load(zone)
role: Requests <zone>.cob and <zone>.odd, creates the terrain object, opens <zone>.gzne

name: TerrainController asset-ready listener
role: Routes TerrainCalendarDefinitions.txt and *.cob data to their parsers

name: TerrainController::Update
role: Per frame: terrain update, creates the cell manager once the terrain is ready, bubble ready check

name: TerrainController::IsLoaded
role: 0 until the terrain is ready and every grid cell around the position is loaded

name: TerrainController::SetPosition
role: Stores the interest position and moves the cell bubble

name: TerrainController::SetRadius
role: Sets the load radius in cells

name: Terrain::Open
role: Stores the name and helpers, calls vtable slot 6 (request <zone>.gzne), creates the 0xd0 byte loader

name: Terrain::RequestHeader
role: Requests '%s.gzne'; returns true only if the request is accepted

name: Terrain asset-ready listener
role: Calls the parser (vtable +0x1c); on failure calls the failure stub (vtable +0x14)

name: Terrain::ParseHeader
role: Checks the GZNE magic, reads the header fields, sets the ready byte at +0x434

name: Terrain::GetCell
role: Cells outside the terrain bounds count as loaded (return 1)

name: CellManager bubble ready
role: Logs 'Bubble not ready, TilesRequested/TilesRecieved' until the first tiles arrived

name: ObjectDeployment::RequestOdd
role: Requests '%s.odd'

name: ObjectDeployment::RequestGroups
role: Requests TerrainObjectDeploymentGroups.txt

name: AssetDeliveryIndirect::Request
role: Manifest lookup; returns 1 and logs 'asset not in manifest' if the name is unknown

name: AssetDeliveryIndirect::IsLocalCurrent
role: Manifest entry and pack entry must both exist and their crc must be equal

name: Manifest::Find (binary)
role: Upper-cases the name, CRC-64, binary search over 16-byte records

name: Asset name normaliser
role: Swaps the extension for the local variant when that file exists

name: PackFile::ReadIndex
role: Reads 0x2000 bytes per index chunk and follows the next-chunk offsets

name: PackFile chunk parser
role: u32 next | u32 count | entries

name: PackFile entry parser
role: Name then three u32 (offset +0xc, length +0x10, crc +0x14)

name: Stream length-prefix reader
role: Endian test: stw 1 / lbz; data is always big endian

name: PackFile::Read
role: Reads length bytes at an offset from the pack
expect: PackFile Error: pack file could not be read

name: PackFileGroup::Read
role: Finds the pack with an entry for the name (case-insensitive hash) and reads it

name: PackFile::Flush
role: Writes the pending index block (writer side)
expect: pack file could not be written

name: HUD::SetLoadingWorldAssets
role: Shows or hides the loading overlay, stores the state in client+0x2a2

name: HUD download indicator
role: Shows the pending download size (kb/mb) via HUD:UpdateLoadingIndicator

name: Main loop terrain check (overlay shown)
role: IsLoaded(camera position) false and overlay hidden: show overlay

name: Main loop terrain check (overlay hidden)
role: IsLoaded(camera position) false and flag 0: SetLoadingWorldAssets(true)

name: Camera::Position
role: Position used by the loaded check: *(camera+0x30)+0x40

name: CRC-64 (manifest key)
role: Table at 0xdb1f10, poly 0x95AC9329AC4BC9B5

name: Tile::Request
role: Requests '<zone>_<x>_<z>.gcnk' (always) and '.gck2' (when the tile flag at +0x4278 is set) through the asset delivery object

name: Tile::Init
role: Stores zone name and coordinates, calls the tile's load slot (vtable +0x1c = Tile::Request); on failure sets the failed flag

name: Tile ctor
role: Sets the tile vtable (0xee3328)

name: Terrain::GetCell (tile cache)
role: Creates and initialises the tile object for an in-range cell

name: Overlay hide radius
role: IsLoaded called with f1 = float at 0xde9d08 (96.0)

name: Tile::IsLoaded
role: A tile counts as loaded after CreateAll(), CreateObjects() and when every object of the tile is loaded; otherwise writes 'Tile at lng:%d lat:%d waiting on ...'

name: Tile asset-ready listener
role: Dispatches by asset kind (1 = .gcnk parser 0x7e7628, 2 = .gck2 parser 0x7e81fc); a failed parse calls 0x7dea50

name: Tile::ParseGcnk
role: Reads the .gcnk contents: 16 sub-chunks (0x40c bytes each), then the object table named 'Chunk_<zone>_<x>_<z>'

name: Thread::RequestStop
role: Stores 1 in the stop byte at *(this+0x94)+8; the loading-screen thread loop and other worker threads test it

name: LoadingScreenThread body
role: Loops while the stop check (0x7ea068) is false: draws a frame (0x185ef8), sleeps 25 ms

name: LoadingScreen::Stop
role: Requests the stop (0x7ea164), joins the thread (0x7ea0f8), releases it and clears the pointer (+8)

name: LoadingScreenManager::Stop
role: Stops the LoadingScreen held at +8

name: LoadingScreenManager::Start(w,h)
role: Restarts the LoadingScreen of the same size (0x18698c) or builds a new one from LOADSCREEN.DDS

name: Client::HideLoadingScreen
role: Stops the manager at client+0xc3c if there is one; the common end of WaitForWorldReady

name: Client::ShowLoadingScreen
role: Starts the manager at client+0xc3c with the size of the screen; sets client+0x148d1

name: Client::ShowLoadingScreenModal
role: Shows the splash, then pumps the network until client+0x14bbd clears or its timeout passes, then hides it

name: WaitForWorldReady
role: Shows the splash at its start; every exit, including the success path after MarketingData.log, hides it (0xc5ca8)

name: WaitForWorldReady common exit
role: Every exit of WaitForWorldReady lands here: r3 = client, then the call of HideLoadingScreen

name: WaitForWorldReady: HUD:SetIsInStartingZone call
role: First thing after the two ClientLog lines are queued: the Lua call HUD:SetIsInStartingZone (0xe43ec)

name: HUD:SetIsInStartingZone caller
role: Calls the Lua function HUD:SetIsInStartingZone(flag) of the UI script

name: Lua VM main loop
role: Big switch over opcodes; one of two RPCS3 shutdown samples of the main thread (0x727768) lies in it, the other (0x7200fc) in lua_getfield 0x71ff9c

name: first Cell vector load in fn_000ee7bc
role: lvlx in the file; Ghidra only decodes it after FrSetup.java rewrites it to lvx

name: SendSelfToClient reader
role: Reads the player blob: counts for every list, scalars, then calls the finisher 0x59de8; no wait or loop depends on a zero count

name: Player-loaded finisher
role: Hands two stored numbers to three setters (0x255df8, 0x763dc, 0x729a0); no waiting

name: Lua UpdateAllQueueStats
role: Script-bound C function (table at 0xec4bb4): sends a 141 sub 1 packet (0x202ea8) and calls 0x252d40

name: Game dispatcher: jump table
role: Table at 0x1051f0 of signed 32-bit offsets from the table, index = opcode - 12 (opcode 93 -> 0x106430)

name: Opcode 93 handler (LoadWelcomeScreen)
role: Reads u8 show, two counted lists and two u32; hands the data to 0x1e7ae4 only if the packet is consumed exactly

name: Welcome-screen state setter
role: Copies the lists into the welcome object and stores the show flag at +0x10 and two ints at +0x14 and +0x18

name: Welcome-screen executor
role: Clears the flag and calls the Lua function OnShowWelcomeScreen; a negative first int means the new-player path
